register_datasets: register datasets from a JSON catalog file with the VISSL dataset catalog
create_VisslDatasetCatalog_register_data: create a dataset entry in the VisslDatasetCatalog by registering a name and data dictionary
get_VisslDatasetCatalog_get: get dataset information from the VisslDatasetCatalog by name
get_data_files: get data and label file paths for a given split and dataset configuration
check_data_exists: check whether input data files or directories exist on disk
